name: PowOS places in Dolphin's sidebar
purpose: The phone's storage (the launcher's Quick launch folders, removable storage) and the owner's other devices (realm registry + owner config POWOS_FILE_PLACES, as sftp:// / smb:// / nfs:// KIO URLs, never kernel mounts) in Dolphin's Places panel: lib/devices/powos-places rewrites only its own tagged bookmarks in ~/.local/share/user-places.xbel, offline devices hidden. Started by the session's autostart; polls local state every 5 s and reachability every 60 s (HACK row in docs/REMOTE-POWOS.md section 4). Python stdlib only; installs no package.
installedBy: targets/android/rooted/powos-deploy.sh (lib/devices, staged by rooted.sh deploy); the PowOS image (Containerfile: lib/ and desktop/autostart/)
unbounded: one small session process, asleep between ticks; probe threads (one per device address) live under 1 s
remove: pkill -f 'powos-places watch'; rm /usr/lib/powos/devices/powos-places /etc/xdg/autostart/powos-places.desktop; rm -r /home/powos/.cache/powos/places. Its bookmarks stay until removed in Dolphin (Places panel, right-click, Remove)
